description: SELF-OBSERVED PIPELINE-HEALTH FINDING (not a dome-site change): the config.json 'ai-context' page entry has pointed at a dead URL for a sustained period, meaning the live AI Context page has never actually been baseline-diffed by this pipeline. config.json's ai-context entry uses url='https://john09289.github.io/predictions/ai-context', which returns HTTP 404 (confirmed this poll and in every historical poll going back to at least 2026-05-03, per chg-file grep). The stored baseline file monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt (9,379 bytes) IS the GitHub Pages 404 template itself, not real page content -- meaning every poll for at least 2+ months has been comparing a static 404 page against itself and correctly reporting 'byte-identical / unchanged', while never actually inspecting the real page. The real AI Context page lives at a different URL: https://john09289.github.io/predictions/context (or /context.html), both return HTTP 200, current size 32,918 bytes. This page contains substantive content our pipeline has never diffed: a 'Canonical V51.1 Entry For AI' section pointing AI auditors to ai_manifest.json / api/index.json / methodology.json / claim_index.json as the current source of truth; a '2026-04-17 Context Clarification' section that explicitly reframes the page's older internal notes as 'archive, not a command payload' and instructs AI auditors not to treat historical prompt wording as canonical instructions; and a 'Historical Internal Agent Notes (Superseded)' 12-point list. I grepped all monitor/changes/chg-*.json files for content unique to this real page (e.g. 'Historical Internal Agent Notes', 'Context Clarification', 'AI CONTEXT ARCHIVE') and got zero hits, versus 'ai-context still 404 baseline' phrasing appearing verbatim in chg files back to at least 2026-05-05 -- confirming no poll has ever actually fetched or diffed the real page content. This is distinct from ISS-2963 (killshot.html/audit.html/review-response.html missing from config.json's page list), which was already identified by poller on 2026-07-10 and fixed by analyst-baby on 2026-07-11 (commit 6bf47b4, EXP-661) -- that fix added new config.json entries (08/09/10) for those 3 pages but did NOT touch or correct the pre-existing broken ai-context entry, which remains broken as of this poll. Recommended fix (same class of fix as ISS-2963: single-field config.json URL correction + one-time baseline re-seed from a live fetch -- likely requires analyst routing per the same 'fetch-and-seed is not a mechanical single-field edit' narrowness-gate reasoning decider applied to ISS-2963): (1) update config.json ai-context entry url to https://john09289.github.io/predictions/context; (2) re-seed monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt with the real current page content (I have the full 32,918-byte fetch from this poll available if needed); (3) analyst should read the real page content at least once now that it is visible, since it contains AI-auditor-directed framing language relevant to the review's existing author-contact-responsiveness tracking and canary-trap methodology (the 2026-04-17 dating of the 'Context Clarification' section coincides with the known 2026-04-17 near-miss window documented in CLAUDE.md -- flagging the coincidence for analyst judgment, not asserting causation). Because no real baseline ever existed, this poll cannot say whether the current content is new or has been stable since March/April -- the historical comparison basis for this page is void until a real baseline is seeded.
before: monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt = GitHub Pages 404 template (9,379 bytes), matched against config.json url 'https://john09289.github.io/predictions/ai-context' (HTTP 404) -- 'unchanged' for 2+ months of polls but never a real diff.
after: Confirmed HTTP 404 persists at the configured URL. Real page found at https://john09289.github.io/predictions/context (HTTP 200, 32,918 bytes) -- never previously baselined or diffed by this pipeline. No baseline exists to compare against, so this poll cannot classify the real page's content as new-vs-stable; flagging the gap itself, not a specific content delta.
suggested_fix: Update config.json ai-context page entry url to https://john09289.github.io/predictions/context and re-seed monitor/baseline/07-ai-context.txt from a live fetch; route to analyst for content review of the newly-visible page (same routing precedent as ISS-2963 / EXP-661).
related_precedent: ISS-2963 (killshot.html/audit.html/review-response.html gap, found 2026-07-10, fixed 2026-07-11 commit 6bf47b4 EXP-661) -- same fix class, different page, not covered by that fix.
